descriptions: Before the patch, `fscanf` used unbounded scanset specifiers to store whitespace/sign runs into caller-provided character arrays, allowing input longer than the destination buffers to overflow stack memory. The fix constrains each scanset write with an explicit field width, so the same sink becomes bounded.

semantic_payload.label: Functions implicated by removed or fixed code

entry_points: Calls to scanf-family functions using `%[` conversions in format literals
suggestions: 首稿先命中 patch-local 最小锚点：`fscanf` format literal containing `%[` without a numeric width.
优先把危险操作本身作为命中条件：未限定宽度的 scanset 写入，而不是先要求证明缓冲区精确大小。
不要把补丁中的 `!= 9` 失败检查写成硬过滤；它只处理解析失败，不阻断扫描时已经发生的越界写。
辅助收敛条件可检查对应实参是否为 `char *`/字符数组，但首稿不必强依赖跨过程求得数组容量。
局部 AST 即可覆盖此补丁语义；只需解析格式串并识别 `%[` 是否带宽度，无需复杂数据流。
若做二次收敛，可优先关注目标实参为局部数组或固定栈缓冲区的场景。
不要把普通 `%s`/`%c` 规则混入首稿；此补丁的稳定锚点是 scanset `%[` specifically.

patterns: Replace `%[` with width-limited `%31[` in the same `fscanf` format string
Constrain each scanset sink at the parsing site instead of relying on later checks
Keep the existing parse-failure branch (`!= 9`) but add a write bound before the dangerous write occurs
